title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + Ubuntu 22.04 EFI support + apt-mirror & rollback tooling
author: Priya Nair
description: Add Ubuntu 22.04 EFI support and package vendoring to the on-prem/airgap offline bundle; improve apt-mirror generation and add rollback tooling. Motivation: customers running RKE2 on Ubuntu 22.04 with EFI boot have reported failures in the offline installer due to missing EFI helper packages and kernel module dependencies in our vendored bundles. This PR vendors required deb packages, updates TUF metadata, adds an improved apt-mirror generation script that produces consistent package indices for air-gapped installs, and introduces a minimal rollback/rollback-plan helper that operators can run post-upgrade to revert package-level changes if validation checks fail. Summary of changes below and testing notes at the end. Checklist: - [x] Vendor required deb packages for ubuntu-22.04 (linux-efi helpers, nvme/virtio drivers, ca-certificates updates) - [x] Update TUF metadata and symlink handling for offline bundle layout - [x] Add apt-mirror generation script that preserves component/arch metadata and supports multiple mirrors - [x] Integrate EFI hooks into installer preflight and package extraction steps - [x] Add rollback-plan script + docs for operator-run rollback - [x] CI: airgap integration tests + local end-to-end on rke2-flatcar/ubuntu-22.04 - [x] Update release notes

release_notes:
- Add Ubuntu 22.04 EFI support to on-prem offline bundles; vendors EFI helper packages and kernel modules.
- Improved apt-mirror generation for air-gapped installs (multi-arch/multi-component).
- Add rollback-plan tooling and operator docs for safe post-upgrade rollbacks.
- Updated TUF metadata for vendored bundles to ensure reproducible verification.
testing_notes: E2E: deployed offline bundle to a local lab cluster (RKE2 on Ubuntu 22.04 w/ EFI) and validated installer extract + service start. Ran airgap integration suite in CI against rke2-flatcar and ubuntu-22.04 matrices; added a flaky tolerance for kernel-module ordering on older kernels. Manual verification: checked SHA256 signatures against TUF targets.json and tested rollback --dry-run then actual rollback on a staging node.
notes_for_ops: Operators should regenerate their apt-mirror using tools/apt-mirror-generate.sh and verify TUF signatures before upgrading. The rollback-plan.sh must be run from a node with access to the vendored packages; use --dry-run first to verify actions.
